review.brief:
Review RM50-analytics-add-tire-pressure-columns (tier 1 of RM50, Linear MAG-56), module internal/analytics.

READ THE DIFF, not the whole module: git diff 53cd233..HEAD (commits 3e74e3b, 3a5d2ea, 9fe7369). Artifacts are at 53cd233.

Validate:
1. Module boundaries (ai/architecture.md). No HTML outside gateway. No module reads another module's DB at RUNTIME. The one cross-schema statement is the backfill migration, a user-confirmed, recorded deviation (RD2 + design.md Part C) -- it is a one-off migration, not a runtime read path. Confirm no Go code imports or queries telemetry's tables.
2. Every DB object matches the user-confirmed design (D-GATE-1): four nullable DOUBLE PRECISION columns, no DEFAULT, NO new index, backfill joining vm.metric_date = vs.captured_date - 1, Down drops the columns only. Any mismatch is a BLOCKER finding.
3. D2 compliance: the four TPMS values are copied verbatim from cur in BOTH branches of deriveVehicleMetrics, including the predecessor-less branch. They must NOT be gated on prev == nil. They are raw observations, not _calc columns.
4. Test-contract rule: the integration tests must assert the expected values design.md's Test Contract authored BEFORE implementation, not whatever the code happens to do. The worker substituted exact binary fractions for the contract's decimal inputs because telemetry.vehicle_snapshots stores TPMS as REAL (float4). Judge whether that substitution changed only the inputs or also weakened an assertion.
5. Migration correctness: version 20260908000002 (renumbered from 0001 after make migration-guard found a collision with internal/account). internal/analytics/testdb_test.go's migrationDirs must keep analytics LAST, matching Makefile MIGRATIONS_DIRS -- reordering it back breaks provisioning.
6. Docs-track-change (CLAUDE.md): AGENTS.md, kkpa/context/entities/vehicle-metrics/guide.md, and kkpa/context/use-case/gateway/read-dashboard-bento.md. openspec/changes/archive/ must be untouched.
7. RD8: no cosmetic tests -- nothing coupled to markup, CSS, ARIA or element placement.
8. Anti-gaming: no acceptance criterion was weakened or deleted, no status self-approved, tasks.md checkboxes match reality.

Which signals were assistant-run vs user-reported:
- ASSISTANT-RUN (leader and worker): go build ./..., go vet ./..., gofmt -l internal/analytics, make migration-guard, make boundary-guard, make tz-guard, make archive-guard. All clean.
- USER-REPORTED (the owner, twice): first run of go test ./internal/analytics/... FAILED on migration ordering, which produced the 3a5d2ea fix; the owner then reported 'make test passed', and after wave 2 reported 'make test-with-db passed'. The assistant ran no test suite at any point. Judge test QUALITY by reading the tests. Do not run them.

Escalate on doubt: return changes-requested asking for leader re-review rather than approving anything you are unsure about.
